headlines.title_en: Shanghai (Yangtze River Delta) International Science and Technology Innovation Center releases phased achievements
headlines.summary_en: The opening ceremony of the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum was held on September 12, where the phased achievements of building Shanghai (Yangtze River Delta) as an international center for science and technology innovation were released in video form. It was mentioned that Shanghai plays a leading and driving role, while Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Anhui each leverage their respective strengths. The three provinces and one municipality share resources, jointly build platforms, jointly cultivate ecosystems and jointly promote reform. Their capacity for scientific and technological innovation sourcing, high-end industry leadership and top talent aggregation is accelerating. The construction of the international center for science and technology innovation has moved from a single-city breakthrough to a new stage of coordinated and integrated development across the Yangtze River Delta region. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 中国移动发布AI可信计算
headlines.summary: 9月12日，在2026中国算力大会主论坛上，中国移动正式发布AI可信计算（AITC）。据悉，AI可信计算基于移动云全栈国产化异构算力底座，融合机密计算、国产密码、信息流隐私防护等核心技术，提供通智多形态机密算力和机密Token，构建覆盖云上AI训练、推理及数据使用全生命周期的一体化AI安全解决方案，让客户像使用私有云一样使用公有云。有效解决金融、政务、工业、医疗、高校科研等数据敏感行业普遍存在的隐私数据易遭泄露、模型资产易被窃取、算力环境信任缺失等上云用智安全痛点。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: China Mobile releases AI trusted computing
headlines.summary_en: On September 12, at the main forum of the 2026 China Computing Conference, China Mobile officially released AI Trusted Computing (AITC). It is reported that AI Trusted Computing is based on Mobile Cloud's fully domestically produced heterogeneous computing power foundation, integrating core technologies such as confidential computing, domestic cryptography, and information flow privacy protection, providing general and intelligent multi-form confidential computing power and confidential Tokens, and building an integrated AI security solution covering the full lifecycle of cloud-based AI training, inference, and data use, allowing customers to use public cloud as they would a private cloud. It effectively addresses common security pain points in cloud and AI adoption in data-sensitive industries such as finance, government affairs, industry, healthcare, and university research, including the easy leakage of private data, the easy theft of model assets, and the lack of trust in computing power environments. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 国家超算互联网用户突破170万
headlines.summary: 中科曙光副总裁曹振南在2026中国算力大会主论坛上披露，国家超算互联网注册用户量已突破170万，累计完成作业量突破2.7亿个，国产算力占比超95%。曹振南介绍，国家超算互联网平台已汇聚CPU核心超350万、GPU卡超25万，日均作业数突破30万个，峰值突破100万个。平台应用商城入驻商户超880家，下单量超24万，覆盖科研创新、人工智能、工业仿真等领域。（界面）

headlines.title_en: National Supercomputing Internet users exceed 1.7 million
headlines.summary_en: Cao Zhennan, Vice President of Sugon, disclosed at the main forum of the 2026 China Computing Power Conference that the National Supercomputing Internet has surpassed 1.7 million registered users, with cumulative completed jobs exceeding 270 million, and domestic computing power accounting for over 95%. Cao Zhennan introduced that the National Supercomputing Internet platform has aggregated over 3.5 million CPU cores and over 250,000 GPU cards, with daily average jobs exceeding 300,000 and peak exceeding 1 million. The platform's application marketplace has over 880 merchants, with over 240,000 orders, covering scientific research and innovation, artificial intelligence, industrial simulation and other fields. (Jiemian)

headlines.title_en: Xi Jinping meets with Indian Prime Minister Modi
headlines.summary_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, on the afternoon of September 12 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Indian Prime Minister Modi while attending the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, India. The leaders of the two countries had a candid and in-depth exchange of views and reached an important consensus that China and India should be partners. Xi pointed out that China has always viewed and developed China-India relations from a strategic height and long-term perspective. Over the past two years, I have met with Prime Minister Modi twice, guiding China-India relations from "starting anew" to achieving "further elevation." Institutional exchanges between the two countries have gradually resumed, the cooperation list has continued to lengthen, and bilateral trade volume has hit a new high. This situation has not come easily and is worth cherishing. China and India have different national conditions, and can fully draw on each other's strengths, support each other, help each other succeed, and develop together. Facing a turbulent and intertwined international situation, China and India, as the world's two most populous countries and important members of the Global South, shoulder important responsibilities. Both sides

headlines.title: 中国算力大会“年度重大突破成果”揭晓
headlines.summary: 2026中国算力大会上，中国算力大会“年度重大突破成果”正式揭晓，15项具有示范性意义的技术成果集中亮相。据了解，2026“算力中国·年度重大突破成果”具有四大特点：一是成果整体技术指标先进，在算力及相关产业领域具备国际先进、国内领先水准，具备行业标杆价值；二是核心技术创新性突出，成果转化落地成效显著，具备较强的行业示范、引领带动与辐射推广作用；三是有效提升行业整体技术能级，赋能产业创新，培育新兴业态，催生新经济增长点；四是注重技术创新的社会效益、经济效益和环境效益，对科技发展具有较大推动作用。

headlines.title_en: China Computing Power Conference announces "Annual Major Breakthrough Achievements"
headlines.summary_en: At the 2026 China Computing Conference, the China Computing Conference "Annual Major Breakthrough Achievements" were officially announced, with 15 demonstrative technological achievements unveiled together. It is understood that the 2026 "Computing China · Annual Major Breakthrough Achievements" have four major characteristics: first, the overall technical indicators of the achievements are advanced, reaching internationally advanced and domestically leading levels in computing power and related industries, and possessing industry benchmark value; second, the core technologies are highly innovative, the results of commercialization and implementation are remarkable, and they have strong industry demonstration, guiding, driving, and diffusion effects; third, they effectively raise the overall technological level of the industry, empower industrial innovation, cultivate emerging business forms, and create new economic growth points; fourth, they emphasize the social, economic, and environmental benefits of technological innovation, and have a significant role in promoting scientific and technological development.

headlines.title: 习近平：中方愿同金砖成员一道，为实现中东海湾地区和平安宁发挥应有作用
headlines.summary: 当地时间9月12日下午，国家主席习近平在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第一阶段会议并发表重要讲话。 习近平指出，中东海湾局势仍在复杂演变。这场战事给地区各国人民造成严重损失，也不符合国际社会共同利益。我提出维护和促进中东和平稳定的4点主张，旨在呼吁缓局降温、止战促和。有关各方要坚持政治解决方向，推动实现永久全面停火。中方愿同金砖成员一道，为实现中东海湾地区和平安宁发挥应有作用。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Xi Jinping: China is willing to work with BRICS members to play a due role in achieving peace and tranquility in the Middle East and Gulf region
headlines.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 12 local time, President Xi Jinping attended the first phase of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi and delivered an important speech. Xi Jinping pointed out that the situation in the Middle East and the Gulf is still evolving in a complex manner. This war has caused serious losses to the people of the countries in the region and does not conform to the common interests of the international community. I put forward four propositions for safeguarding and promoting peace and stability in the Middle East, aimed at calling for de-escalation and cooling down, ending the war, and promoting peace. Relevant parties should adhere to the direction of political settlement and push for the realization of a permanent and comprehensive ceasefire. China is willing to work with BRICS members to play its due role in realizing peace and tranquility in the Middle East and Gulf region. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 中国工程院院士邬贺铨：2030年中国算力有望占到全球30%
headlines.summary: 在9月12日2026中国算力大会主论坛上，中国工程院院士邬贺铨指出，智能体的出现带动了Token的消费。今年3月，Token的消费已经达到日均140万亿。随着技术进步，Token的消耗并不是以多为荣，而是以效率为荣。中国Token的应用成本不断下降，这也促进了Token的利用。Token带动算力，算力和Token之间成正比。目前，中国的算力在全球占21%，美国占46%，按照国家算力网的规划，2030年中国算力有望占到全球30%。

headlines.title_en: Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Wu Hequan: China's computing power is expected to account for 30% of the global total by 2030
headlines.summary_en: At the main forum of the 2026 China Computing Conference on September 12, Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Wu Hequan pointed out that the emergence of intelligent agents has driven Token consumption. In March this year, Token consumption had already reached an average of 140 trillion per day. As technology advances, Token consumption is not about taking pride in using more, but about taking pride in efficiency. The application cost of Tokens in China continues to decline, which has also promoted Token utilization. Tokens drive computing power, and computing power and Tokens are directly proportional. At present, China accounts for 21% of global computing power, while the United States accounts for 46%. According to the national computing power network plan, China's computing power is expected to account for 30% of the global total by 2030.

headlines.title: 关于深入推进算力高质量发展，工信部最新发声
headlines.summary: 以“共织算力网 智启新未来”为主题的2026中国算力大会在河北廊坊开幕。工业和信息化部总工程师钟志红在开幕式上致辞。 钟志红表示，算力已成为数智时代不可或缺的新型信息基础设施。“十五五”规划纲要明确提出，构建多层次算力设施体系和全国一体化算力网。为深入推进算力高质量发展，服务国家重大战略和经济社会发展需要，在此，提四点建议。 一是强化系统谋划，提升算力利用效能。推进算力设施有序建设，加快构建枢纽、区域、边缘多层次梯次化算力架构，持续完善中国算力平台功能，促进算力资源统筹监测和高效利用。

headlines.title_en: Latest statement from MIIT on deepening high-quality development of computing power
headlines.summary_en: The 2026 China Computing Conference, themed "Weaving the Computing Power Network Together to Wisely Open a New Future," opened in Langfang, Hebei. Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Chief Engineer Zhong Zhihong delivered a speech at the opening ceremony. Zhong Zhihong said that computing power has become an indispensable new type of information infrastructure in the digital intelligence era. The outline of the 15th Five-Year Plan clearly proposes building a multi-tier computing power facility system and a nationwide integrated computing power network. To further advance the high-quality development of computing power and serve the needs of major national strategies and economic and social development, he put forward four suggestions here. First, strengthen systematic planning and improve the efficiency of computing power utilization. Promote the orderly construction of computing power facilities, accelerate the building of a hub, regional, and edge multi-tier and tiered computing power architecture, continuously improve the functions of China's computing power platform, and promote coordinated monitoring and efficient utilization of computing power resources.

headlines.title: 乘联分会崔东树：本轮乘用车市场下行属于阶段性结构性波动
headlines.summary: 乘联分会秘书长崔东树发文称，2026年8月车市零售环比回升5.5%，是油价高位压制、宏观景气偏弱、政策预期升温、成都车展带动等多重因素交织共振的结果。地缘冲突持续困扰霍尔木兹海峡的通航，推动国际油价维持高位震荡，2026年国内汽油价格累计上调已超1720元/吨，尤其7月底以来上涨了180元，大幅抬高了燃油车用车成本，国内燃油乘用车消费需求持续剧烈萎缩。8月制造业PMI环比回升0.6%至49.8%，仍处于荣枯线之下，终端内需边际虽回暖但力度有限。8月上中旬高温假抑制终端到店客流、下旬成都车展带动市场热度回升、月末冲量拉动日均零售修复，终端订单与客流呈现前低

headlines.title_en: CPCA's Cui Dongshu: This round of downturn in the passenger vehicle market is a phased structural fluctuation
headlines.summary_en: Cui Dongshu, Secretary-General of the China Passenger Car Association, wrote in an article that in August 2026, car market retail rebounded 5.5% month-on-month, the result of a combination of multiple factors including high oil prices weighing on the market, weak macroeconomic sentiment, rising policy expectations, and the boost from the Chengdu auto show. Ongoing geopolitical conflicts continue to trouble navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, pushing international oil prices to remain volatile at high levels. In 2026, domestic gasoline prices have cumulatively risen by more than 1,720 yuan per ton, including an increase of 180 yuan since the end of July, greatly raising the cost of using fuel vehicles, and domestic fuel passenger vehicle consumer demand has continued to shrink sharply. In August, the manufacturing PMI rebounded 0.6 percentage points month-on-month to 49.8%, still below the boom-or-bust line. Although marginal terminal domestic demand warmed somewhat, the momentum was limited.
